Adds Command Code model access, live model "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"catalog, plan-aware model selection, reasoning effort, image input, web search, and multi-account su"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"g, plan-aware model selection, reasoning effort, image input, web search, and multi-account support."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-commandcode-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for **Command Code**, ported from pi-commandcode-pro"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"eepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for **Command Code**, ported from pi-commandcode-provider (MIT)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> Community integration. You need your own Command Code account, API key or subscription, and Comman"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"d Code's terms apply. Not affiliated with Command Code, Inc."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Verified engines | dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.4`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.2-alpha.2`, `0"},{"id":"p7s2","text":".2.2-alpha.3`, `0.2.2-rc.1` |
| Node.js | **`>=24.9`** — raised from 22 in 0.16.0, see Node.js 24.9 "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"or newer |
| Install — web | `dsh plugin --profile web add @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider@latest"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"` |
| Install — terminal | `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider@late"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"st` |
| Config file | `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` → `llm-commandcode:` |
| API key env | `COMMANDCODE_"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"API_KEY` |
| Usage dashboard | `/commandcode` |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Plugin bundle** — one `dsh plugin add` installs a `commandcode` provider route with the live mod"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"el catalog.
- **Settings page** — accounts (keys, browser sign-in, live quota, dedicated models), mo"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"del visibility, privacy switches, connection options.
- **Annotated catalog** — plan tier, deal/`FRE"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"E` badge, peak/off-peak, image support and context window in the picker; free models first.
- **Cust"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"om model names** — override a model's display name by catalog id so external tools that match on the"},{"id":"p9s6","text":" name string (peak-hour reminders, cache-pricing plugins) keep working; the model id, request body, "},{"id":"p9s7","text":"pricing and picker order are unchanged.
- **Multi-account rotation** — an exhausted account hands ov"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"er to the next one; pin a preferred account or route models to dedicated ones.
- **Browser sign-in**"},{"id":"p9s9","text":" — run the official authorization flow from the settings page; the approved key lands in the local c"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"redential store.
- **Plans & quota panel** — optional sidebar card with the serving account's plan, "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"5-hour and weekly windows, balances and reset times.
- **Session cost estimate** — published-rate es"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"timates (`≈`) beside the composer token counter, priced per request from durable session history.
- "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"**Model analysis** — tokens, estimated cost, response timing and failures by session or date range. "},{"id":"p9s14","text":"Scope.
- **Web search** — the dsh `web_search` tool is served by Command Code (`/alpha/web-search`) "},{"id":"p9s15","text":"with the same key and endpoint as chat.
- **Zero data retention** — optional ZDR routing (`x-cmd-zdr"},{"id":"p9s16","text":": 1`), off by default.
- **Context & output limits** — override the metered context window globally "},{"id":"p9s17","text":"or per model, and cap or omit the per-turn `max_tokens`.
- **Reasoning effort & images** — effort le"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"vels in the picker; Vision models accept images.
- **Terminal UI** — the same install serves a dsh-T"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"UI profile with its own `/settings` → Command Code page."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Model picker** — plan tier, deal/FREE, peak/off-peak, Image and context annotations:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Usage dashboard** — `/commandcode` per-account report:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Settings page** — accounts with live quota, model visibility, privacy switches, connection options"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"*Settings page** — accounts with live quota, model visibility, privacy switches, connection options:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"This build admits **dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0`** — every RC of the `0.2.1` channel from `0.2.1-rc.2"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"` onward — **and `>=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.2.3-0`**, the `0.2.2` channel from its current alpha. `0.2.1-rc"},{"id":"p16s3","text":".5` is what npm `latest` runs, `0.2.2-rc.1` is on `next`, and `0.2.2-alpha.3` on `alpha`. All seven "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"are covered by the full engine matrix (`npm run test:engine`, `npm run test:install`). A later relea"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"se of either channel is admitted without a plugin update, but stays unverified until a record is add"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ed to `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`. `0.2.3` and later are deliberately excluded — the upper bound"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"s are written `<0.2.2-0` / `<0.2.3-0` for exactly that reason. A profile on `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-alp"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ha.5` or older must upgrade its engine first. Compatibility details — the `engines.dsh` admission ru"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"le, package pairings, evidence — live in engine compatibility."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Node.js 24.9 or newer is required"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**The Node.js floor was raised from 22 to 24.9 in 0.16.0. On Node 22 or 23, upgrade Node before upda"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" was raised from 22 to 24.9 in 0.16.0. On Node 22 or 23, upgrade Node before updating this plugin.**"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Notes & limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Image input is model-gated** — only Vision models accept images; text-only models refuse them, a"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nd dsh rejects switching a text-only model into an image-bearing session. The adapter reports the si"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ze actually put on the wire (long edge 1568, encoded bytes capped at 1 MiB), and the provider caps a"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" single request (around 50 MB, undocumented); images beyond that budget are replaced by a short "ima"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ge omitted" note, and an over-sized request is retried once with a smaller image budget.
- **No `sto"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"p` sequences** — requests carrying one fail.
- **Historical reasoning is replayed on both transports"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"** so a tool-calling loop keeps its chain of thought: `/provider/v1/chat/completions` passes it back"},{"id":"p21s8","text":" as `reasoning_content`, `/alpha/generate` carries it as a `reasoning` block inside the rebuilt assi"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"stant turn. Only tool calls with a paired tool result are replayed.
- **Tool parameter schemas are n"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ormalized** to the object root the provider requires, so a tool declared without one (a third-party "},{"id":"p21s11","text":"plugin's hand-written schema, an MCP server's `inputSchema`, a generated root `$ref`) no longer fail"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"s the turn with `schema must be a JSON Schema of 'type: "object"'`.
- The model catalog is browsable"},{"id":"p21s13","text":" without a key; chat requests need one."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Permissions & privacy"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The plugin only communicates between your local dsh profile and your Command Code account: locally i"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"t touches only the credential store and the models cache (plus `~/.commandcode/auth.json` as a last-"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"resort fallback); on the network it calls only the Command Code API. No telemetry. With **zero data "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"retention** on, chat requests require a ZDR upstream; models without one fail instead of running wit"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"hout the protection."}],"truncated":true}
